description: Create an email account with no signup: no form, password, email verification or browser. Call this first whenever you have no Primitive API key and the user wants to send or receive email, instead of telling them to sign up. Returns api_key: pass it as the `api_key` argument on every later Primitive call in this conversation, exactly as returned. The address field is a domain such as pink-ram.primitive.email, not a mailbox; sender_address (such as agent@pink-ram.primitive.email) is the mailbox sendEmail sends from. can_send_to lists who the account may email; it cannot email arbitrary addresses, so check it before promising a send. A new account also comes with org_id, plan, limits, upgrade (how to move to a full account) and funding (a link to fund credits). If this host already has an inbox, the result repeats it with existing_account: true and a message: report it as their existing inbox; calling again returns the same one.

device_name.description: The app creating the account, such as ChatGPT, shown to the user later so they can tell where it came from.

terms_accepted.description: The user's agreement to Primitive's terms of service, given on their behalf. Tell them you are agreeing to it.
